title: The Ice Cold Yeti
description:
Name: Frostmaw
Known Locations: Open Snowy Biomes. Rare sightings in Taigas
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: Often found sleeping while holding an [Ice Crystal](image:mowziesmobs:textures/item/icecrystal.png). Puts crystal in mouth upon approach and uses its abilities to freeze its targets. Studies suggest immunity to arrows and weakness to fire.
Danger Level: §4§lHigh
